originalTitle: Will global vanadium production (mine + co-product, contained V) in 2027 be at least 140,000 tonnes of V?
title: 2027 年全球钒产量会达到 14 万吨 V 吗？
Will global vanadium production reach 140,000 t V in 2027?
rules: 2027 年全球矿产与副产的钒元素含量产出 ≥140,000 吨为 Yes，优先 USGS。
Yes requires ≥140,000 t contained V in global mine/co-product output in 2027, prioritizing USGS.
USGS 缺失或明显不一致时，按至少两个可靠行业来源的中位数；2029-12-31 仍无 2027 数据则 N/A。
If USGS is unavailable or clearly inconsistent, use the median of at least two credible sources; no 2027 figure by 31 December 2029 resolves N/A.
interpretation: 这是供应量门槛，不是电池消耗量。要核对元素 V、年度和统计版次；原题的 2024 年基数有冲突，不能据此计算可靠增长率。
This is a supply threshold, not battery consumption. Match contained-V units, year and edition; conflicting contract baselines prevent a reliable growth calculation.

stage: 矿产／副产 → 可用钒 → 电解液供应
impact: USGS 统计系列可以追踪世界供应，但钢铁仍是重要用途中间环节，电池级电解液并不等于全部钒产量。把元素吨口径、重复计量及纯化步骤说明后，读者才有依据判断供应扩张与液流电池材料之间的关系，而不是把矿产预测直接换成储能规模。

USGS tracks world supply, while steel use and electrolyte purification separate total output from battery-ready material. Contained-metal units, double counting and processing boundaries are necessary before relating a supply forecast to flow-battery deployment.
gap: 市场背景的约 119 kt 与 109 kt 基数不一致；回收量是否被主表覆盖仍需查目标年度表注。
The background’s roughly 119 kt and 109 kt baselines conflict; recycling coverage needs the target-year notes.

title: 钒供应：元素吨与电解液不是同一数量
Vanadium supply: contained tonnes and electrolyte volume
principle: 钒既用于钢铁合金，也用于液流电池电解液。全球钒产量不能全部视为电池可用材料；进入电解液还涉及纯化、价态配置和供应分配。统计中的 V 元素吨与 V₂O₅ 吨数须按化学组成区分。

Vanadium supplies steel and flow-battery electrolytes. Global output is not all battery-ready: purification, oxidation-state control and allocation intervene. Contained-V tonnes differ from tonnes of V₂O₅.
example: 本题问 2027 年 ≥140,000 吨 V，并给出 USGS 优先、备用来源中位数和 2029 年数据等待期。市场背景的两种 2024 基数不一致，本站保留提示；不把钢铁副产供给直接换算成液流储能 GWh。

The contract asks for ≥140,000 t V in 2027, prioritizes USGS, specifies a fallback median and waits for data through 2029. Its inconsistent 2024 baselines remain flagged; steel co-product output is not converted to flow-storage GWh.
